title: Canonical native scalar API and removal of lattice compatibility infrastructure
status: Implementation committed on main and local functional qualification complete. Native scalar wins and machinery deletion are retained with small measured matrix regressions explicitly recorded. Full Hypercurve release readiness, uniform geometry performance, and full slow-fixture memory accounting remain open.
exactcorelib_mining_and_idea_uplift: Already closed by preceding checkpoints; this follow-on API cleanup does not reopen or newly close that milestone.

change.scalar_authority: Hyperreal owns scalar construction, arithmetic, domain errors, cancellation attachment, and structural type names. Hyperlattice consumers call Real methods directly; Complex::i owns the imaginary unit.
change.type_only_proof: Map old names to canonical names, normalize renamed reexports, and remove whitespace. The thirteen production files below have equal normalized SHA256 before and after; no arithmetic or topology change is attributed to this renaming.

scalar_public_functions_retained.reciprocal_checked: Requires structural NonZero before Real::inverse; Unknown returns UnknownZero without refinement; Zero returns DivideByZero.
scalar_public_functions_retained.reciprocal_ref_checked: Same structural-only contract without consuming the input. Native Real::inverse_ref may instead refine an Unknown divisor to prove nonzero.

change.scalar_abort_api: Attach a caller-owned AbortSignal with Real::abort before native scalar operations. Structural zero_status never refines or inspects cancellation.
change.private_matrix_helper_proof: Nineteen bodies matched their checked counterparts after replacing the non-refining abort zero query; two additional forwarding bodies then matched. Arithmetic cancellation attachment remains in genuinely abort-aware paths. checked_pivot uses one native structural classifier, not a generic closure.
change.public_matrix_removal_reason: These eight methods attached no signal to arithmetic and only routed through the non-refining zero-query wrapper. Checked triangular operations remain; no alias or replacement wrapper is added.
new_regressions: Structural zero queries and checked scalar reciprocals preserve Zero, NonZero, and Unknown with active and inactive cancellation.
Native invalid-domain errors remain authoritative with active and inactive cancellation.
A structurally Unknown divisor stays rejected by the checked reciprocal until native inverse_ref refines and proves nonzero.
All 22 finite scalar certificate recipes, four signed scales, and both cancellation states retain every invalid ln/log10/asin/acos domain certificate.
Hypercurve endpoint tangents expose canonical ZeroKnowledge for zero, pi, and negative exact components.

source_integrity.aggregate_algorithm: SHA256(JSON.stringify(sorted tuples [relative path, SHA256(file bytes), byte length])). Files are Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and every src/**/*.rs, sorted by relative-path localeCompare. Final digests match those captured before functional qualification; test/fuzz source hashes are listed separately for Hyperlattice.

frozen_baseline.description: Snapshot after canonical type renaming but before scalar facade and matrix-helper removal; sibling Hyperreal symlink points to unchanged qualified Hyperreal. The baseline is not the raw parent revision.

validation.scope: All recorded processes finished. Test counts sum independent test binaries, including doctests when present; they are not deduplicated across feature configurations. Production fingerprints are unchanged after these gates.
